answer: With a Verified email inbox bound by in-person pickup code with one identity per channel, the account is only as strong as its binding: the verified email inbox answers a fresh challenge, the in-person pickup code is recorded, and one identity per channel keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so losing the channel means losing the identity, and fakes cannot hide behind throwaway channels. The record keeps every zephyr visible, so anyone can audit the binding roll. The hollow keeps the process honest and the canyon keeps it open, so challengers can always recheck.
